constants.accountingInvariant: available + reserved + release_pending + refund_pending + recovered == deposited

authority.sourceRule: Mandate authority_constraints and expected_authority are host identities; they are lower-cased, bounded, and may not contain '/', '@', or spaces.

transport.sourceRule: _url_host requires an exact https:// prefix, a non-empty authority, no whitespace, no '#', no credentials, and a host of at most 253 characters.

remainingLifecycle.signature: register_counterparty(Address bound_wallet, str label, str authority_origin) -> str

inputs.bound_wallet: nonzero Address; duplicate wallet identity is rejected
inputs.label: required string, length <= MAX_SHORT_TEXT
inputs.authority_origin: transport URL parsed by _url_host; stored as the lower-cased hostname identity

rules.address: wallet must not already be in counterparty_by_wallet
rules.url: exact HTTPS URL; no credentials, whitespace, '#', or empty host
rules.state: counterparty identity capacity must not be exhausted
rules.mandate: no direct mandate-state requirement; later Intent creation binds C-1 to active M-1

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: creates C-1, appends counterparty_identity_ids, indexes wallet, records COUNTERPARTY_REGISTERED history
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: get_counterparty('C-1') is active, bound_wallet is signer, label matches, authority_origin is docs.genlayer.com

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: caller equals the mandate principal; Core must be bound

rules.mandate: mandate status must be DRAFT or SEALED
rules.accounting: creates/updates mandate account and preserves conservation
rules.replay: no protocol duplicate guard; runner must preflight exact existing deposit and never top up beyond 1

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: deposited and available increase by msg.value; global totals increase by msg.value
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: M-1 accounting is deposited=1, available=1, all other buckets=0, conserved=true

remainingLifecycle.signature: create_intent(str mandate_id, str counterparty, Address recipient, u256 amount, str title, str purpose, str deliverable, str commercial_terms, str fulfillment_criteria, u256 expires_at) -> str

inputs.recipient: nonzero typed Address; qualification recipient is the bound counterparty wallet
inputs.amount: positive and <= maximum_single_transaction; qualification amount is 1
inputs.text: title, purpose, deliverable, commercial_terms, fulfillment_criteria required and each <= MAX_TEXT
inputs.expires_at: strictly greater than current chain time and <= mandate expires_at

rules.budgets: amount is checked against single cap; Vault reserve later checks epoch and total budgets
rules.recipient: stored immutably in the Intent; no alternate recipient is permitted by runner

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: creates I-1 in DRAFT with counterparty authority/fingerprint and empty authorization/fulfillment
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: I-1 fields equal typed fixture and status=DRAFT

rules.timing: intent is not expired at chain_now

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: sets submitted_at, status=SUBMITTED, and immutable intent_fingerprint
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: I-1 status=SUBMITTED and fingerprint is a 64-character hash

remainingLifecycle.signature: define_evidence(str intent_id, str evidence_kind, str origin_url, str expected_authority, str expected_hash, u256 committed_byte_length, str approved_recovery_authority, u256 sequence) -> str
remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: caller equals Intent agent or principal

inputs.evidence_kind: one of source-valid evidence kinds; PRODUCT_SERVICE is used for authorization
inputs.origin_url: exact HTTPS URL whose parsed host equals expected_authority
inputs.expected_authority: lower-cased host identity permitted by sealed mandate
inputs.expected_hash_and_length: both empty/zero or a 64-hex hash paired with length <= MAX_SOURCE_BYTES
inputs.approved_recovery_authority: optional host identity; defaults to expected_authority and must be policy-allowed

rules.binding: evidence policy fingerprint binds to Intent

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: append-only evidence definition E-1; not yet captured
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: E-1 origin/authority/hash/length/sequence exactly match typed calldata

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: source-defined public write; evidence definitions must exist

inputs.intent_id: I-1 with at least one uncaptured definition

rules.capture: authenticated capture must be HTTP 200, non-empty, <= MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, host/policy/hash/length consistent
rules.consensus: leader and independent validator capture results must be valid and equal
rules.failure: infrastructure/malformed capture stores retry or repair status; it is not completion

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: source-defined public write; evidence must be EVIDENCE_READY

inputs.semanticOutput: dynamic GenVM pavel-authorization-v1 result; runner must not hardcode a favorable result

rules.schema: exact schema plus twelve boolean semantic fields and bounded explanation
rules.consensus: independent semantic results must be valid and agree
rules.decision: all required booleans true => AUTHORIZED; otherwise REJECTED; malformed/disagreement => AUTHORIZATION_RETRY_REQUIRED
rules.safety: UNASSESSED, retry, rejected, or inconclusive never satisfy Vault authorization

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: authorization record with snapshot, mandate fingerprint, intent fingerprint, semantic vector and decision
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: positive path requires status=AUTHORIZED and authorization.decision=AUTHORIZED

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: caller is Core authorization agent or principal; Core auth view must say AUTHORIZED

rules.crossContract: Core get_authorization_for_vault must match authorized Intent, mandate, recipient, amount and fingerprints
rules.mandate: SEALED (or revoked with allow_prior_reservations); intent and mandate not expired
rules.accounting: available >= amount; amount <= single cap, epoch budget and total budget
rules.replay: intent_id must not already be reserved

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: available decreases by 1, reserved increases by 1, committed and epoch_spent increase by 1, reservation status=RESERVED
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: reservation matches I-1/M-1/recipient/amount and accounting remains conserved

rules.safety: absence of an authorization record is not AUTHORIZED and must not be converted into a live negative write

remainingLifecycle.postcondition: proof records UNASSESSED_NOT_CLEARED and no transaction hash

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: source-defined public write; Intent status AUTHORIZED

rules.crossContract: Vault reservation must exactly match Intent and be RESERVED

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: caller equals Intent agent or principal

rules.binding: append-only after authorization evidence; URL/hash/length rules identical

remainingLifecycle.postcondition: sequence 1 definition is bound to I-1 and policy authority

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: public write; uncaptured fulfillment definition exists

rules.capture: same authenticated HTTPS and hash/length rules; no favorable result is assumed

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: authenticated fulfillment snapshot and EVIDENCE_READY/pending source state
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: fulfillment evidence is captured; failed capture is retry/repair, never success

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: source-defined public write; Intent FULFILLMENT_PENDING and matching RESERVED reservation

inputs.semanticOutput: dynamic pavel-fulfillment-v1 result; no favorable hardcode

rules.schema: nine boolean fields, outcome FULFILLED/NOT_FULFILLED/INDETERMINATE, bounded explanation
rules.consensus: independent vectors and outcome must agree
rules.outcomes: FULFILLED -> RELEASE_TO_COUNTERPARTY; NOT_FULFILLED -> REFUND_TO_PRINCIPAL; INDETERMINATE/error -> retry state and no settlement

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: fulfillment record, settlement direction, ready_at=chain_now+challenge_window for determinate result
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: positive path requires FULFILLED and RELEASE_TO_COUNTERPARTY

rules.challenge: qualifying open challenge returns CHALLENGE_BLOCKED and oldest_open_challenge
rules.timing: runner waits on chain time >= ready_at, never wall clock

remainingLifecycle.postcondition: direction RELEASE_TO_COUNTERPARTY, no qualifying open challenge, ready_at reached

remainingLifecycle.callerRequirement: Vault public write; Core settlement instruction authorizes release

rules.replay: derived settlement id must not already exist
rules.external: recipient is immutable reservation recipient; native amount is reservation amount

remainingLifecycle.expectedMutation: reservation RELEASE_PENDING; reserved decreases; release_pending increases; settlement external_observation=UNCONFIRMED before message
remainingLifecycle.postcondition: settlement exists with RELEASE_PENDING and nonempty settlement_id; parent finalization does not prove external delivery

challenge.positiveFlowRule: No challenge exists, so the positive flow must not require a second signer; if a qualifying challenge appears, settlement is blocked until source-defined adjudication/expiry rules resolve it.

accounting.perMandate: available + reserved + release_pending + refund_pending + recovered == deposited
accounting.global: total_available + total_reserved + total_release_pending + total_refund_pending + total_recovered == total_deposited
